image_description: A group of people in traditional or folk-style clothing dancing around a tall wooden maypole in a grassy clearing surrounded by trees. The maypole is decorated with long, multi-colored ribbons (streamers) extending from the top to the dancers' hands. The scene depicts a May Day celebration.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur or depth-of-field blur affects the background foliage and some peripheral figures, which is common in photography but can also mask AI generation inconsistencies. It reduces texture clarity.

The ribbons lack distinct physical thickness and crisp edges where they overlap. They appear somewhat 'painted on' or fused together near the top convergence point, lacking realistic shadowing between individual strands.

The hands of the dancers, particularly the woman in the white dress on the right, show slight morphological ambiguity. Fingers blend into the ribbon material without clear grip definition, a common AI artifact in hand-object interaction.
